title.zh: Grok 4.7发布：长任务与安全能力升级
title.en: Grok 4.7 Targets Longer Tasks and Safer AI

excerpt.zh: Grok 4.7面向编程与知识工作升级长任务处理、自我校验和安全防护，并以每百万输入令牌2美元起提供API服务。
excerpt.en: Grok 4.7 improves long-horizon coding, verification, and safeguards, with API pricing starting at $2 per million input tokens.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Grok 4.7是SpaceXAI于2026年9月21日公布的新模型，重点面向编程和知识工作。官方称，它采用更大的基础模型，并通过更长的强化学习训练处理需要数小时完成的复杂任务；模型也更擅长管理长上下文、检查自身结果，以及完成文档和演示文稿。
text.en: Grok 4.7 is a new model announced by SpaceXAI on September 21, 2026, with a focus on coding and knowledge work. The company says it uses a larger base model and a longer reinforcement-learning run aimed at tasks that can take hours. It is also designed to manage longer context, verify its own work, and produce documents and presentations more effectively.

text.zh: 价格与基准成绩形成主要卖点
text.en: Pricing and Benchmarks Form the Main Pitch

text.zh: Grok 4.7的API价格从每百万输入令牌2美元、输出令牌6美元起，与Grok 4.6列出的价格相同；另有输出速度翻倍、价格翻倍的快速版本。官方基准显示，Grok 4.7在CursorBench 4.0编程测试中得分46.3%，高于Grok 4.6的40.4%，并在DeepSWE、EEBench、AA Briefcase等项目上展现出竞争力。不过，不同测试衡量的任务并不相同，部分结果涉及高努力模式，因此单一分数不足以代表真实使用体验。
text.en: API pricing starts at $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens, the same prices listed for Grok 4.6. A fast variant doubles output speed at twice the price. The company reports a 46.3% score for Grok 4.7 on CursorBench 4.0, compared with 40.4% for Grok 4.6, along with competitive results on DeepSWE, EEBench, and AA Briefcase. These tests measure different tasks, however, and some results use a high-effort mode, so no single score fully predicts real-world performance.
Safety Claims and the Open Questions

text.zh: 官方还强调了全新的安全防护栈：在其披露的测试中，Grok 4.7在生物安全基准上达到62.4%，并在HackerBench v0.3中仅让3.3%的高风险双用途提示通过，同时尽量减少对合法安全工作的误拦截。模型目前已在Cursor、Grok Build、Grok API、第三方编程工具和云平台提供。需要保留的限制是，这些性能与安全数字来自发布方及其引用的基准，尚缺乏本文来源之外的独立验证；实际效果还会取决于任务、工具链和使用者提供的上下文。
text.en: SpaceXAI also highlights a new safeguard stack. In the company’s disclosed testing, Grok 4.7 scored 62.4% on a biosafety benchmark and allowed only 3.3% of risky dual-use prompts through on HackerBench v0.3, while aiming to avoid blocking legitimate security work. The model is available in Cursor, Grok Build, the Grok API, third-party coding harnesses, and cloud platforms. The main limitation is that these performance and safety figures come from the publisher and the cited benchmarks; independent verification is not provided in the source. Actual results will also depend on the task, tools, and context supplied.
